cmd:
mkdir -p /app/vectorops/vectorops && cat > /app/vectorops/vectorops/__init__.py << 'EOF'
def dotproduct(a, b):
    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
EOF
cat > /app/vectorops/pyproject.toml << 'EOF'
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "vectorops"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Simple vector operations"
requires-python = ">=3.8"
EOF
cd /app/vectorops && ls -R
cd /app/vectorops && pip install build 2>&1 | tail -2 && python3 -m build 2>&1 | tail -5 && ls dist
pip install pypi-server 2>&1 | tail -2 && mkdir -p /app/packages && cp /app/vectorops/dist/* /app/packages/ && ls /app/packages
which pypi-server && nohup pypi-server run -p 8080 -i 0.0.0.0 /app/packages > /app/pypi-server.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:8080/simple/ | head -20
pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0 2>&1 | tail -3 && python3 -c "from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); print('OK')"
pip show vectorops | head -3; ps aux | grep -c "[p]ypi-server"; curl -s http://localhost:8080/simple/vectorops/ | grep -o 'vectorops-0.1.0[^"<]*' | head -3
